verdict.rationale: The evidence shows Postman has a gateway product: the Fabric Gateway quickstart registers MCP servers with "the gateway". So the gateway-traffic axis applies. However, nothing in the pack documents enforcing API key, OAuth2, JWT or mTLS authentication on upstream APIs through gateway plugins or policies. The "Built-in authentication" item covers client-side request authorization, which is an adjacent feature and earns no credit.

support.subject: As a platform-engineer, I can enforce authentication (API keys, OAuth2, JWT, mTLS) on upstream APIs via gateway plugins or policies
